title: Attic conversion with en suite, Dublin 13
summary: An attic converted into a bedroom with a rooflight bay, a dressing space and an en suite shower room.
intro: We converted this attic into a full bedroom floor. The main room opens into a bay under two rooflights, with access panels to the eaves storage on both sides.
A small dressing space leads through to an en suite shower room, also lit by two rooflights.
